description: This source file defines the DocumentPreview class, a Windows Forms user control used to render and preview MigraDoc documents in a GUI application. It handles document rendering, page navigation, zoom adjustments, and visual customization for the preview display.

classes.name: DocumentPreview
classes.description: A Windows Forms user control that provides a visual preview of a MigraDoc document, supporting navigation, zoom, and customization.

methods.name: GetNewZoomFactor
methods.description: Calculates the next zoom level based on the current zoom and whether the zoom should be increased or decreased.

methods.name: DdlUpdated
methods.description: Parses and loads a MigraDoc document from the DDL string, updating the renderer and resetting the page view.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Handles the rendering of a specific page onto the provided graphics context for preview purposes.
